TAB-FULL:v1p77#2/r1.claim: Shuqayq recounts Ibn Abbas preaching and explaining Surat al-Nur from the pulpit, adding that the Romans would have become Muslim had they heard him.
TAB-FULL:v1p77#2/r1.anchor: عن شقيق، قال: «شهدت ابن عباس وولي الموسم، فقرأ سورة النور على المنبر، وفسرها

TAB-FULL:v1p77#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v1p77#2/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v1p77#2/r2.claim: Al-Tabari cites God's commands to reflect on Quranic verses and take heed from their examples, arguing that these commands presuppose comprehension of accessible meanings.
TAB-FULL:v1p77#2/r2.anchor: كتاب أنزلناه إليك مبارك ليدبروا آياته وليتذكر أولو الألباب

TAB-FULL:v1p77#2/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v1p77#2/r3.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v1p77#2/r3.claim: He argues it is absurd to command people who do not understand Arabic to learn from an Arabic poem; they must first understand its language, then reflect.
TAB-FULL:v1p77#2/r3.anchor: محال أن يقال لبعض أصناف الأمم الذين لا يعقلون كلام العرب ولا يفهمونه

TAB-FULL:v1p77#2/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v1p77#2/r4.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v1p77#2/r4.claim: Therefore, those who know Arabic can understand verses whose interpretation God has not reserved; this defeats rejection of commentators' explanations of accessible verses.
TAB-FULL:v1p77#2/r4.anchor: فسد قول من أنكر تفسير المفسرين من كتاب الله وتنزيله، ما لم يحجب عن خلقه تأويله

BURHAN:v4p36/r11.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p36/r11.speaker: ابن السيد
BURHAN:v4p36/r11.claim: Ibn al-Sayyid prefers the Joseph antecedent on the basis of the rescued man remembering after a period.
BURHAN:v4p36/r11.anchor: ورجح ابن السيد هذا لقوله تعالى ﴿ وقال الذي نجا منهما وادكر بعد أمة ﴾ 2 أي بعد حين

BURHAN:v4p36/r12.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p36/r12.speaker: ابن عامر
BURHAN:v4p36/r12.claim: Ibn Amir reads the word with a light mīm to mean forgetfulness, which explains the rescued man's later recollection after forgetting.
BURHAN:v4p36/r12.anchor: وفي قراءة ابن عامر بعد امه بالتخفيف أي نسيان وإلا لم يكن ليذكر تذكر الفتى بعد النسيان

BURHAN:v1p297/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p297/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p297/r1.claim: Morphology has two broad divisions: deriving word forms for varied meanings and changing forms through addition, deletion, substitution, inversion, metathesis, or assimilation; it is essential to exegesis.
BURHAN:v1p297/r1.anchor: والثانى تغيير الكلمة لمعنى طارىء عليها وينحصر فى الزيادة والحذف والإبدال والقلب والنقل والإدغام وفائدة التصريف حصول المعانى المختلفة

BURHAN:v1p297/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p297/r2.speaker: ابن فارس
BURHAN:v1p297/r2.claim: Ibn Faris says lacking morphology means missing most of the language, because inflection clarifies distinctions such as forms of وجد and the contrast between injustice and justice.
BURHAN:v1p297/r2.anchor: قال ابن فارس من فاته علمه فاته المعظم لأنا نقول وجد كلمة مبهمة فإذا صرفناها اتضحت

BURHAN:v1p297/r3.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p297/r3.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p297/r3.claim: The dāl in ادّكر and مدّكر replaces dhāl: ادّكر derives from اذتكر and مدّكر from مذتكر, with assimilation; the root is ذ ك ر, not an independent d-k-r root.
BURHAN:v1p297/r3.anchor: فإن الدال فى الموضعين بدل من الذال لأن ادكر أصله اذتكر افتعل من الذكر

BURHAN:v1p334/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p334/r2.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p334/r2.claim: The second type changes case endings or vowels without changing the written form but does change meaning; it is accepted when transmitted soundly and compatible with Arabic.
BURHAN:v1p334/r2.anchor: الثانى الاختلاف فى إعراب الكلمة فى حركات بما يغير معناها ولا يزيلها عن صورتها فى الخط

BURHAN:v2p208/r5.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p208/r5.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p208/r5.claim: The word أمة is given with several senses across the Qur'an: a group, an exemplary leader, a religion, or a period of time.
BURHAN:v2p208/r5.anchor: وكالأمة فى قوله تعالى ﴿ وجد عليه أمة ﴾ بمعنى الجماعة وفي قوله ﴿ إن إبراهيم كان أمة ﴾

BURHAN:v3p194/r3.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p194/r3.speaker: author
BURHAN:v3p194/r3.claim: فأرسلون suppresses several clauses: send me to Joseph so I can ask about the dream, they send him, and he comes to Joseph; the request's purpose is clear from the interpreters' failure.
BURHAN:v3p194/r3.anchor: فإن التقدير فأرسلون إلى يوسف لأستعبره الرؤيا فأرسلوه إليه لذلك فجاء فقال له يا يوسف

ITQAN:v4p445/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v4p445/r1.speaker: author
ITQAN:v4p445/r1.claim: The Qur'anic orthography omits the final yāʾ from فأرسلون wherever it occurs in this category; the list gives no exception for this form.
ITQAN:v4p445/r1.anchor: وحيث وقع ( أطيعون ) ( اتقون ) ( خافون ) ( ارهبون ) ( فأرسلون )

ITQAN:v2p315/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p315/r5.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p315/r5.claim: Here بعد أمة means after a period of time.

DAMGHANI:v1p59/r9.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p59/r9.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p59/r9.claim: The entry also lists āyāt as lessons, scripture, and commands or prohibitions, without giving their examples in this excerpt.

DAMGHANI:v1p42/r5.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p42/r5.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p42/r5.claim: Umma can mean a measured period of years; this is how the source reads the delay before the survivor remembered Joseph.
DAMGHANI:v1p42/r5.anchor: الثالث : امة يعني سنين معدودة . قوله تعالى في سورة هود

DAMGHANI:v1p42/r9.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p42/r9.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p42/r9.claim: The entry also lists the Muslim community, unbelievers, and all creation as senses of umma, but gives no examples for these in this excerpt.
DAMGHANI:v1p42/r9.anchor: الأمم الخالية . امة محمد . الكفار . الخلق

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r1.speaker: ابن قتيبة
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r1.claim: Ibn Qutayba gives الأمة the basic sense of a human kind or group.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r1.anchor: قال ابن قتيبة : أصل الأمة : الصنف من الناس والجماعة

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r2.speaker: ابن قتيبة
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r2.claim: Another lexical use of الأمة is a period of time.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r2.anchor: قال ابن قتيبة : أصل الأمة : الصنف من الناس والجماعة . ويقال : الأمة ، ويراد بها الحين

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r3.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r3.claim: The word may also mean a leader or a learned, God-fearing man.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r3.anchor: ( 17 / ب ) [ الأمة ] ، ويراد بها الإمام والرباني

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r4.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r4.claim: A further lexical sense of الأمة is religion.

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r5.speaker: النابغة
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r5.claim: Al-Nābigha's line is cited as poetic evidence for الأمة meaning religion.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r5.anchor: والأمة : الدين . قال النابغة : وهل يأثمن ذو أمة وهو طائع

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r6.speaker: ابن فارس
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r6.claim: Ibn Fāris gives الأمة the sense of stature, supported by a line describing people as tall.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r6.anchor: قال ابن فارس : والأمة : القامة ، في قول القائل : -

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r7.speaker: ابن فارس
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r7.claim: Ibn Fāris also gives الأمة the sense of abundant blessing.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r7.anchor:
قال ابن فارس : والأمة : القامة ، في قول القائل : -
وإن معاوية الأكرمين … حسان الوجوه طوال الأمم
والأمة : الكثيرة النعمة

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r10.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r10.speaker: أهل التفسير
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r10.claim: In 12:45, الأمة means a period measured in years, as it also does in Hud.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r10.anchor: والثالث : الحين . ومنه قوله تعالى في [ هود ] : ﴿ ولئن أخرنا عنهم العذاب إلى أمة معدودة ﴾ ، وفي يوسف : ﴿ وادكر بعد أمة ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r11.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r11.speaker: ابن قتيبة
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r11.claim: Ibn Qutayba explains the time sense by analogy: a human community is a generation that passes within a period, so الأمة came to stand for that period.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p142/r11.anchor: قال ابن قتيبة : كأن الأمة من الناس ، القرن ينقرضون في الحين ، فأقيمت الأمة مقام الحين
